summary.en: Collection days depend on where you live (ward and town area). Use the City of Nagoya "garbage collection day search" and choose your ward and town. In the city's sorting app "San-A-ru" you can set your area to see a calendar, with an alarm function. Bulky waste is collected once a month, on a day set for each area.
